rules.title: Neighbourhood rules
rules.intro: Kwatt is the neighbourhood playing together. These rules apply to everyone, profiles and guests. By creating your profile, you accept them.

s1.title: Respect
s1.body:
We play, we tease, we don't hurt.

• No insults, threats, racist, hateful or sexual remarks, and no harassment.
• Your username, your game name and the names of your rooms and leagues stay decent: banned words are refused.
• You don't pretend to be someone else, or the Kwatt team.

s2.title: Fair play
s2.body:
• No outside help during a ranked game: no software, no game engine, no advice from someone else.
• One profile per person. No arrangements to lose or to make someone win.
• The server checks every move and every stake; the Ludo die can be verified after the game.

s3.title: Cowries
s3.body:
Cowries are play money, nothing else.

• They can't be bought or cashed out: they are never worth real money.
• Selling, buying or trading them for money or goods is forbidden.
• Kwatt shows no advertising.

s4.title: Age and stakes
s4.body:
• Under 13: no profile, guest play only.
• 13 to 17: young account, with no stakes, no predictions, no paid leagues, invisible to strangers.
• Staking and predicting: 18 and over, with a verified email address.
• A stake never exceeds 25% of the smallest balance among the players, nor the table limit.
• Two accounts seen on the same device never stake against each other.

s5.title: Reporting, sanctions
s5.body: If someone breaks these rules, report or block them. Depending on how serious it is: a warning, removal from a league, suspension or closure of the account. A false year of birth may also lead to the account being closed.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: Kwatt keeps the minimum needed to run the game. No advertising, no selling of data, no tracking.

s1.title: What Kwatt keeps
s1.body:
• Your profile: username, email address, password (never in clear text: only an argon2id hash), year of birth (never shown: it sets the age rules), language, frame, avatar, photo if you add one, neighbourhood and settings.
• Your play: games and moves, levels, stakes, cowrie history, cards, medals, friends and notifications.
• Your device: a random installation identifier, the type of device and the app version. It is used for security and to forbid stakes between accounts on the same device.
• Your phone's notification token, if you accept notifications.
• As a guest: an account tied to the device, with no email or username, and the name you give for the game.

s2.title: Why
s2.body: Only to run Kwatt: playing, ranking, protecting accounts (limited tries, 6-digit codes), fighting cheating, sending you service emails (verification code, password, account deletion) and the notifications you chose.

s3.title: Who sees what
s3.body:
• Other players see your username, avatar, level, neighbourhood and games. Your email address and year of birth are never shown.
• A young account is only visible to its friends.
• Kwatt doesn't sell or rent your data. Only the services that are needed process part of it: sending emails, and delivering notifications through Expo, Apple and Google.

s4.title: Where and for how long
s4.body: Your data is on the Kwatt server, with a daily backup kept for 14 days. It stays as long as your account exists.

s5.title: Deleting your account
s5.body:
Settings → Delete account: your profile is hidden right away, then permanently erased 30 days later. Sign in again before then to cancel.

On erasure, your username, address, devices, settings and notifications disappear; in other players' games, you become “Former player”. Backups erase themselves within 14 days.

s6.title: Your rights
s6.body:
• A copy of your data: Settings → Export my data (JSON file).
• Correction: your username can be changed in Settings; for anything else, write to the Kwatt team.
• Deletion: see above.

For any question, write to the Kwatt team at the address shown on the app's page in the app store.

s7.title: Security
s7.body: Encrypted connections, passwords never kept in clear text, session tokens stored in your phone's secure storage and renewed regularly.
